tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches only s_grad = 2.44, below the proposed onset at 2.50–2.68. A targeted high-gradient probe is the cheapest relevant measurement for testing whether the response departs from the smooth subcritical trend.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five gradients are below the proposed onset range, so the threshold and siphon strength are unconstrained.
The pilot varies input and gradient together, so its plateau cannot distinguish smooth input inhibition or a power-law response from the proposed threshold mechanism.
Costs more and does not directly target the unresolved high-gradient regime.
